paper.title: Automated Surgical Phase Recognition Using Temporal Convolutional Networks
paper.authors: Smith J, Jones A, Williams B, et al.

body.label: Problem
body.text: Automated phase recognition in laparoscopic cholecystectomy remains error-prone under occlusion and instrument changes.

body.label: Methods
body.text: Temporal CNN trained on 80 annotated cholecystectomy videos; tested on 20 held-out cases.

body.label: Results
body.text: Mean phase accuracy 91.3% (vs. 85.2% for prior LSTM baseline). Weakest on critical view of safety phase (84.1%).

body.label: Conclusion
body.text: Temporal CNNs outperform recurrent models for surgical phase recognition at moderate dataset scale.
